day12Task.title: Build a Responsive Navigation Bar & Mobile Drawer
day12Task.description: Day 12 of the ABTalks 60-Day Challenge focuses on mastering mobile-first UI components. Your objective is to design and implement a fluid navigation header with active state routing, a glassmorphism blur effect, and a smooth responsive drawer for small viewports (390px).
learningObjectives: Ensure touch targets are at least 44px for mobile devices
Add interactive state transitions using Tailwind CSS
submissionRequirements: Public GitHub repository commit link displaying your component code
